breaking: Legacy desktop configuration is no longer migrated automatically: the app loads defaults and leaves the original file untouched on startup. Legacy update-preference fields are ignored; use startupUpdate and periodicUpdate instead.
features: Deliverables now support files outside the project, using absolute paths or paths relative to the session directory. Plugins can preview and reveal external files using absolute paths; directory browsing and standalone project reveal remain restricted to the project.
changed: Plugin management now scrolls the installed-plugin list independently, keeping filters and list controls visible and limiting the height of the direct-install panel.
fixed: Fixed chat position shifts when switching sessions: ended conversations stay at the latest user message, while running conversations in follow mode open directly at the bottom, even as the initial layout expands.
